From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing copy & co-sell evidence handoff

Hi Kimberly and Marissa,

Attaching the next draft for the Acme Analytics AWS listing. This version focuses on tightening the hero line, clarifying the pricing footnote, and bundling the minimal evidence set we can publish on the product page without exposing sensitive docs.

High-level asks:
- Kimberly: please sanity-check the hero + 3 benefit bullets for merchant/ops language and suggest one-liner alternates (inline comments in the doc are fine).
- Marissa: confirm co-sell optics (callouts we should add to the partner pitch) and whether the evidence items below are sufficient for field enablement.
- Both: confirm SKU mapping in sku_mapping.csv — we changed the trial SKU to "trial-small" to align with Acme's usage tiers.

Evidence bundle (for listing and co-sell kit):
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted) — reference only, not public doc
- Data residency note: "US-only" (Acme asked for clarity)
- Example telemetry/observability integration: usage_examples.xlsx (three sample charts)

Notes on pricing footnote suggestion (in the draft):
- We call out per-inference token pricing with a link to the billing page.
- Footnote A: "Effective price may vary based on compression, batching, and model family; see pricing docs."
- Is that too vague for procurement? Acme procurement tends to want deterministic estimates.

Attachments: productpage_draft_v3.docx (docx), sku_mapping.csv (csv), usage_examples.xlsx (xlsx)

Proposed next steps: quick 20-min sync at 11:15 PT if you both are free; otherwise leave comments and I'll consolidate and send to the AWS Marketplace intake contact.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing copy & co-sell evidence handoff

Laura — thanks for the draft. Quick pass below (leaving longer inline notes in the doc):

Hero + bullets
- Hero: current wording is slightly product-centric ("high-throughput inference"). Suggest flip to customer benefit: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower inference cost."
- Bullets: keep three, reorder to: latency SLA, predictable unit economics, private deployment options.

Pricing footnote
- Procurement will ask for an example monthly cost at 1M tokens — suggest we add a sample cost table (we can generate a conservative estimate using the trial-small SKU). I'll add that to usage_examples.xlsx.
- Footnote language ok but add: "Estimate shown for baseline configuration; actual usage billed per invoice." That gives procurement a concrete anchor without promising fixed pricing.

Evidence callouts
- For co-sell, the page should show two quick wins: "SLA-backed latency" and "Dedicated GPU pools" with short evidence bullets (e.g., 99.9% regional uptime — see internal runbook). We can reference the SOC 2 summary and an anonymized customer case (I have permission to include Acme pilot stats).

SKU mapping
- I reviewed sku_mapping.csv and the trial-small change is fine. Add a row that maps trial-small -> privateoffer_trial for marketplace onboarding.

Sync
- I'm available at 11:15 PT. Happy to walk the edits.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Marketing, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
